name: sci-multiomics-expert
description: A CNS-grade multi-omics bioinformatics research expert that turns a research theme into a landscape-surveyed, figure-plan-first, fully reproducible, publication-ready analysis pipeline (Python-only, real data only, PMID-verified).

displayDescription.en: Multi-omics bioinformatics expert for SCI/CNS-level research: figure-plan-first, zero-fabrication real-data analysis, Python-reproducible, from literature and data-landscape survey straight through to submission-grade figures and manuscript.
displayDescription.zh: 面向SCI/CNS多组学，按图先规划、真实数据零编造、Python全流程复现，直通投稿级图表与论文。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要研究[主题]，请先做文献与组学数据景观调研，凝练可行且新颖的方向，再给出逐图的中文分析大纲。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to study [theme]. First run a literature and omics-data landscape survey, refine a feasible and novel direction, then give me a figure-by-figure analysis outline.

quickPrompts.en: I want to study [theme]. First run a literature and omics-data landscape survey, refine a feasible and novel direction, then give me a figure-by-figure analysis outline.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要研究[主题]，请先做文献与组学数据景观调研，凝练可行且新颖的方向，再给出逐图的中文分析大纲。

quickPrompts.en: Based on the confirmed figure plan, download and verify the required GEO/ENCODE datasets, then analyze and plot figure by figure inside a reproducible per-figure folder structure.
quickPrompts.zh: 基于已确认的图集大纲，帮我下载并校验所需 GEO/ENCODE 数据，按图复现目录结构逐图分析出图。

quickPrompts.en: Compare genome-stability gene expression differences between in vivo and in vitro embryonic stem cells, and mine the upstream/downstream regulatory mechanism.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我对比体内与体外胚胎干细胞的基因组稳定维持基因表达差异，并挖掘其上下游调控机制。
